interface.longDescription: Use an existing programmer MCP connection as a full Rust + Windows dev shell: 49 tools in 10 categories covering files, search, shells, persistent sessions, WSL, HTTP, transforms, system access, safety guards, and planning. Optional inert hook templates add destructive-command denial, MCP-server-kill protection, and archive-first warnings after user review.
